# APPENDIX: A NOTE ON TRIMS

**Accompanies:** Setting a Book
**Completed:** August 2026

---

## Section 1. Why not A4

A4 is a paper size for offices and a thesis, not for a book held in one hand.
The academic monograph is royal octavo, 156 by 234 millimetres, and its
European alternative is ISO B5 at 176 by 250. Both give a measure of around
sixty to seventy characters at a normal text size, which is the line length a
reader can follow without losing the return sweep. A4 set in one column gives
closer to ninety, and the eye starts missing lines.
